title: Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Preliminary Efficacy Study of CDZ173 in Patients With Primary Sjögren's Syndrome
brief_summary: This Study is designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and preliminary therapeutic efficacy of oral administrations of CDZ173 in patients with primary Sjögren's syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of primary Sjögren's syndrome (pSS)
* ESSDAI score ≥ 6 at screening visit

Exclusion Criteria:

* Secondary Sjögren's syndrome

Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria may apply.
